statements.notes: Built from two sourced signs: ME (british-sign.co.uk: 'Index finger points at signer', also covers I) and SORRY (signs.json: 'Closed hand makes a circular motion on chest'). The order ME SORRY is our gloss; it has not been checked by a fluent BSL signer, and BSL also allows SORRY ME. The apologetic facial expression carries meaning and is not checked.

signs.instruction: Point your index finger at your chest from the side.
signs.notes: Source: 'Index finger points at signer.' (the same sign covers I). Same handshape as ONE; the meaning is the pointing direction, which this hand (no wrist) cannot show and the checker does not judge, so approximated: handshape only. Kept out of signs.json for that reason (it would duplicate ONE there); it is only taught inside a statement. The instruction says 'from the side' because a finger pointing straight back at the signer points away from the webcam and MediaPipe reads it as curled (seen live, 17 Oct: index read 98-123 degrees); side-on it reads straight. Thumb folded assumed (source silent).

signs.instruction: Point your index finger at the other person, side-on.
signs.notes: Source: 'Point with index finger at the person being referred to.' Same handshape as ONE and ME; the pointing direction is the meaning and is not checked. 'Side-on' because a finger pointing at the webcam is foreshortened and reads as curled (same problem as ME). Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Hold a closed fist against your chest.
signs.notes: Source: 'Closed hand held to chest.' Also covers mine. Same handshape as SORRY (fist, thumb folded assumed); the chest location is not checked. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Thumbs up: closed fist, thumb up, small push forward.
signs.notes: Source: 'Make short forward movement using closed hand with thumb up (1 or 2 hands).' Also covers great (and hi/hello, which the phrasebook sends to HELLO instead). Thumb spread 0.3 is my estimate for a thumb held up beside the fist. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Flat hand, fingertips on chin, then move it down and away.
signs.notes: Source: 'Flat hand starts with fingertips on chin. Hand moves down and away from signer.' Also covers thanks and please. Flat hand = all four robot fingers straight, thumb alongside; little finger not modelled. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Open flat hand, wave it near the side of your head.
signs.notes: Source: 'Wave hand near side of head.' Also covers hi and goodbye. Flat open hand assumed (source silent on handshape). Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Flat hand moves down your chest, then twists out.
signs.notes: Source: 'Flat dominant hand moves down chest then twists out.' Also covers need. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Bent flat hand: fingertips tap one side of chest, then other.
signs.notes: Source: 'Dominant hand bent. Fingertips tap far side of chest then near side of chest.' A bent hand bends at the knuckles, which the curl measure (middle and end joints) reads as nearly straight, so the target is a slight curl (0.2). Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Index and middle fingers out together, tips touch chin.
signs.notes: Source: "Tips of index and middle finger ('N' shape) touch chin then wrist twists so fingertips are facing forwards." 'N' shape = index and middle fingers out, ring curled, thumb folded (assumed); same handshape as TWO. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Index and middle fingers out together, tips touch forehead.
signs.notes: Source: "Tips of index and middle fingers ('N' shape) touch forehead. Hand twists forwards at wrist until fingers are facing forwards in front of face." 'N' shape = index and middle fingers out, ring curled, thumb folded (assumed); same handshape as TWO. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Index and middle fingers out together, touch your ear.
signs.notes: Source: "Index and middle fingers extended ('N' shape) touch ear." 'N' shape = index and middle fingers out, ring curled, thumb folded (assumed); same handshape as TWO. Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

signs.instruction: Curve your hand round an imagined glass, tip it to your mouth.
signs.notes: Source: 'Dominant hand mimes drinking out of a glass.' Also covers glass, tumbler, beer. Handshape is a C around an imagined glass: fingers half curled, thumb out opposite them (my estimate, source silent). Approximated: only the handshape is checked; location and movement are not.

phrasebook_notes: words: English word or two-word phrase -> sign id, only where the sign's source lists that word (its own entry or 'also covers'). skip_words have no sign of their own in BSL and are dropped. Signs follow the typed English order, not BSL grammar. cannot_sign: words we looked up whose BSL sign this one four-fingered hand cannot make (sources.md); they are skipped with that reason instead of a plain 'no sign yet'.
